description: Registrar General's Department - The List of Wataries in Sri Lanka - 31st December 2021
categorisation: This gazette contains a list of notaries public with their judicial divisions, office locations, appointment dates, and languages. Notaries public are judicial officers appointed to authenticate documents and perform other legal functions. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it concerns the appointment and listing of officers who perform specific legal authentication duties within the judicial system.
